questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Information Communication Technology tools have brought in additional changes along with means of communication.

B. These changes have enabled man to communicate faster.

C. The result is a more relaxed life than ever before.

D. Communication has not only become faster but easier too.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., ‘ABDC’.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When arranging sentences, it is easier to order the first few; and then eliminate the options accordingly. 
 
• The first sentence of a paragraph is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 
 
• Here, only A is independent and introduces the subject of the passage which deals with Information Communication Technology tools.
 
• Sentence **A **talks about how the tools have made changes.
 
• It should be followed by B which states the effects of these tools. 
 
• So, B must come after C. Then AB is the correct order.
 
• This order is shown in both **options 1 and **3.
 
• Sentence **C** talks about the overall result from the subject under discussion and hence, should come in the end. 
 
• This order is only shown in option 4, which shows the full sequence as: ABDC.

Thus, the correct sequence is: ABDC

**A.** Information Communication Technology tools have brought in additional changes along with means of communication.

**B.** These changes have enabled man to communicate faster.

**D. **Communication has not only become faster but easier too.

**C.** The result is a more relaxed life than ever before.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

He gave Kaveri a beautiful yellow dress.

options.text: Kaveri was given a beautiful yellow dress by him.
Kaveri has given a beautiful yellow dress by him.
Kaveri is given a beautiful yellow dress by him.
Kaveri has been given a beautiful yellow dress by him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e., '**Kaveri was given a beautiful yellow dress by him.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an assertive sentence.
 
• We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of an assertive sentence.
 
• Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
 
• In the given sentence the subject is he, while the object is Kaveri.
 
• **He **should be changed to him.
 
• Use preposition by before agent. (him)
 
• Always use the past tense form (was given) of the main verb (gave) in passive form. 
 
• At last line up the remaining part. 
 
• Following these steps, we finally get - Kaveri was given a beautiful yellow dress by him.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Inspector: “Were you sleeping when the robbers entered the bank?”

B. Guard: “The iron grill lock was broken and the bank looked ransacked but the robbers could not take away anything as I had returned quickly.”

C. Inspector: “What did you see when you came back?”

D. Guard: “No Sir. The bank had closed and | had just gone to relieve myself.”
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., 'ADCB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When arranging sentences, it is easier to order the first few; and then eliminate the options accordingly. 
 
• The first sentence of a paragraph is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 
 
• Here, only A is independent and introduces the questioning by the Inspector. 
 
• It should be followed by D which provides the guard's answer to the question asked by the Inspector.
 
• So, D must come after A. Then AD is the correct order.
 
• This order is shown in option 4, which shows the full sequence as: ADCB.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is: ADCB

**A.** Inspector: “Were you sleeping when the robbers entered the bank?”

**D.** Guard: “No Sir. The bank had closed and | had just gone to relieve myself.”

**C.** Inspector: “What did you see when you came back?”

**B.** Guard: “The iron grill lock was broken and the bank looked ransacked but the robbers could not take away anything as I had returned quickly.”

• Hence, **segment 3** is incorrect making **option 3 **the correct answer. 
 
• ***Correct sentence - ***Several prominent film stars / have appeared on television /** to raise awareness **/ about hand hygiene.
